_comment: #590 canonical: Olesm's seal-funding row is gated on the warden, as Pisces' THE CHOICE row is (#440 holds: every Act V ending is a post-fight resolution). Loads seal_fed_gate_start (both reads taken, warden armed, seal_warden_downed not banked) via title Continue. Flow: the Guild steps, where the hub is whole-list pinned WITHOUT the ward row -> the alcove warden, sprung from its approach cell and won under autoplay -> the same hub, now pinned WITH the ward row last -> the row opens seal_bounty_pitch, and its exit leaves without paying. NEGATIVES: the pitch never renders before the warden is down, and neither seal_kept_fed nor seal_resolved banks.

steps._comment: Down to Continue; confirm loads the seal_fed_gate_start manual slot.
== THE GUILD STEPS, WARDEN STANDING == bump up into Olesm (29,3) from (29,4). He carries a real talk_pool, so the first interact this waking is a bark and the second opens olesm_intro.

#590 NEGATIVE, THE GATE. WHOLE-LIST option pin with the ward read and the warden standing: the TALK-path row is GONE, because accomplishment gates hide and its gate now compounds seal_warden_downed. Drop that leg and this pin reds with the ward row appended last.

payload_contains.text: The gallery's sealed and the report is filed, which means my column finally has its number. I would still rather there were nothing under my streets at all. The file says 'under control'. I will take it. My thanks, again.

options.text: [Appraise Foe] What's the city's real weak point?
It's dead. Zevara's sealing the gallery.
I'll leave you to your tally.
You run half this city from that desk. You know that, right?

steps._comment: Row 4 is his exit. Nothing on this hub can reach seal_bounty_pitch now.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Fed, on a schedule, with no end written anywhere. A posting like that sits on the ledger forever. Every quarter, somebody new asks why we're paying a Gnoll to walk down and feed a door, and every quarter somebody has to be brave enough to sign it again.
